Questions and answers

Questions and answers

What is 失去推进力?

In this glossary, 失去推进力 refers to: Loss of ability to propel the vessel due to engine failure or other mechanical issues.

How is 失去推进力 used in maritime?

In maritime communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "MV Sunrise失去推进力，在航道中漂流，急需拖船协助，请所有船只避让。"

Why does 失去推进力 matter in maritime?

失去推进力 matters because it supports clear communication in External Communication contexts for Deck Officers, Engine Officers, and Masters. It also connects to aviation training and exam language such as STCW, Marlins Test, ISF Watchkeeper, and GMDSS.

Who uses 失去推进力?

失去推进力 is mainly used by Deck Officers, Engine Officers, and Masters.

Definition

Loss of ability to propel the vessel due to engine failure or other mechanical issues.

Operational example

MV Sunrise has lost propulsion, drifting in fairway, immediate tug assistance required, all vessels keep clear.
